purpose: Confirm source basis of already-fixed Q62 loan prohibition after full6 grading; no new rule, bank edit, key change or canonical change
operative_text: If a player trades away a card with their background on it, it must be returned at the end of the turn. Cards without player backgrounds, such as colonies and research teams, are traded away permanently.
interpretation: Original rules classify temporary owner-background card transfers as trades. Relic Detector explicitly may not be traded, so the ordinary background-card loan permission does not create a Relic Detector exception. The original printed Relic Detector card is already in the frozen source corpus and was natively reviewed by audit07.
reader_isolation: This note is not supplied to full7 readers or graders.
